analysis:
PMUY was launched on 1 May 2016 with a target of 5 crore deposit-free LPG connections for BPL women; the target was later raised to 8 crore by March 2020. The CAG (December 2019) found 7.19 crore PMUY connections, about 90% of the target with a year left.

On use, the CAG found average refills of PMUY households fell from 3.9 in 2016-17 to 3.0 in 2018-19, compared with 6.7-7.5 for other consumers. It found 17.61% of beneficiaries never took a second refill. It also recorded verification gaps and installation delays.

The CAG concluded the scheme largely met its connection goal but that sustained LPG use was the real measure of success. This entry assesses the connections promise; it does not address cleaner-cooking outcomes in later years.
